subject: Tenancy split + edge nodes for upcoming contract extension
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stratushealth.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@stratushealth.io
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Tenancy split & edge node plan for upcoming term

Hi Vivek / Neha,

Quick background: as we approach the contract extension (exp. 12/15) our security and ops teams have requested a tenancy split between analytic workloads and PHI-backed inference. They also want two edge nodes in the EU and APAC regions to satisfy regional latency and geo-residency for a subset of traffic.

Questions for Redwood:
- Can the private deployment be split into two isolated VPCs under one contract?
- What are the lead times and what changes to our current Dedicated footprint will be required?
- Does this trigger any changes to the term/pricing (we expect an increase in committed capacity)?

Would like to get a short mutual action plan and a rough quote this week so procurement can review. Attaching our internal network diagram (high level).

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Director, Cloud Ops | Stratus Health
A: +1 415-555-0191

Attachments: stratus_network_sketch.png (image)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stratushealth.io>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@stratushealth.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenancy split & edge node plan for upcoming term

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear ask and the diagram. We can do the tenancy split (two VPCs with strict network separation and separate cluster pools) under a single contract; typical approach is:

1) Provision two isolated control-plane-managed environments (one per tenant) with dedicated cluster pools.
2) Add two regional edge clusters (EU / APAC) configured as read-through inference nodes with routing rules.
3) Configure KV cache and prefix routing so low-latency traffic prefers the regional edge and PHI traffic is pinned to the PHI-only tenant.

High-level lead times: 6–8 weeks for full provisioning and testing if we have the peering details and firewall rules; 3–4 weeks if you accept a phased approach where we stand up the PHI tenant first and add edge clusters after canary testing.

I've attached a draft SOW and a preliminary quote for committed capacity. Neha, Logan — can you review the design and call out any non-standard infra items?

Next steps proposed:
- Procurement: review attached quote + confirm desired term and committed GPUs
- Ops: share peering CIDRs and firewall window
- Redwood: finalize SOW and schedule kickoff (we can do a 30-min technical kickoff this week)

Happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
M: +1 650-555-0123

Attachments: SOW-tenancy-split-v1.pdf, redwood-quote-2026Q4.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stratushealth.io>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenancy split & edge node plan for upcoming term

Alicia — quick technical notes from our infra team:

- Isolation model: we'll use strict tenant-scoped clusters (no cross-tenant KV sharing). PHI tenant will be deployed in your VPC with customer-managed KMS keys; we will add HSM-backed key integration if required (separate charge).
- Edge clusters: these will run smaller GPU instances optimized for low-latency (e.g., A10/A16 class), with a regional fallback to the nearest central cluster for heavy loads.
- Networking: need CIDR ranges for peering, and at least two maintenance windows for canary testing. If you have strict IP allowlists, please provide those ASAP.
- Data routing: we will provide routing rules that evaluate a policy (payload tags + origin IP) to keep PHI traffic on the PHI tenant.

I attached the design diagram that clarifies the peering and routing. Two items for procurement: exact committed GPU count (we recommended the quote for 8 dedicated T4-equivalent units across tenants + 2 edge nodes) and whether you want a 12- or 24-month term (pricing stepdown at 24 months).

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

Attachments: design-diagram-edge-nodes.png

From: procure@stratushealth.io <procure@stratushealth.io>

Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenancy split + edge nodes for upcoming contract extension

Vivek / Team,

Thanks — procurement reviewed the quote. A few items before we can move to legal/doc signing:
- Pricing: can you provide a line-item that separates the edge-node charges from the tenant isolation setup? We need clarity for internal cost allocation.
- Term: our finance prefers a 12-month initial term with an option to extend at 12 months. Is there any discount/commit delta if we sign 12 vs 24 months?
- SLAs: confirm latency SLOs for edge nodes (p99 inference latency target) and the incident escalation path into Redwood's Dedicated support.

Please send an updated quote and SOW; we will circulate to legal once we have that.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Sourcing Manager | Stratus Health
procure@stratushealth.io

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenancy split + edge nodes for upcoming contract extension

Samir — thanks for the list. We'll update the quote and SOW to show: separate line items for tenant isolation setup, per-edge-node recurring charge, and committed GPU units. High-level pricing delta: 12-month term = standard list; 24-month term = 8% committed discount (applies to committed GPU spend).

SLA notes:
- Edge nodes: p99 inference latency target of <120ms for the EU node and <150ms for APAC (subject to configured model and sequence length); detailed SLO table to be included in the SOW.
- Support: Dedicated customers get our priority on-call routing; we'll include a named escalation contact and a two-hour response target for Sev1 incidents tied to the committed capacity.

Action items / timeline:
- Redwood: updated quote + SOW (Vivek) — 48 hours
- Stratus: confirm committed GPU count + preferred term (12 vs 24) — by EOD 11/12
- Kickoff: schedule 30-min technical kickoff after SOW sign-off

I'll circulate the updated artifacts (SOW v1.1 and cost sheet) and open a HubSpot deal with the updated lines.

Thanks — Vivek
